query: SELECT p.id FROM businesses.staff_phone p WHERE p.linked_by = $1 AND p.business_id = $2 AND NOT p.is_main AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM businesses.esign_consent c JOIN businesses.team_member m ON m.id = c.member_id AND m.business_id = c.business_id WHERE c.business_id = p.business_id AND c.line_id = p.id AND c.channel = 'text' AND m.removed_at IS NULL) ORDER BY p.linked_at, p.id
